description: This Java abstract class 'AbstractSnapshotTuner' provides utility methods for applying changes to Liquibase XML change logs within the OpenMRS project. It handles reading, writing, and updating changelog files, as well as managing license headers, and parsing XML documents.

classes.name: AbstractSnapshotTuner
classes.description: An abstract class providing methods for managing Liquibase changelog files during database schema updates in OpenMRS, including license header insertion and XML document manipulation.

methods.name: updateChangeLog
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses for updating the XML Document representing the changelog.

methods.name: addLicenseHeaderToFileIfNeeded
methods.description: Checks if the license header is present in a file, and adds it if missing.

methods.name: createUpdatedChangeLogFile
methods.description: Reads, updates, and writes a new Liquibase changelog file based on a source file.

methods.name: getNamespaceUris
methods.description: Returns a map of namespace URIs used in XML documents.

methods.name: addLicenseHeaderToFileContent
methods.description: Reads a file's content and prepends the license header if needed.

methods.name: deleteFile
methods.description: Deletes a specified file if it exists.

methods.name: isLicenseHeaderInFile
methods.description: Checks if the specified file contains the license snippet.

methods.name: readChangeLogFile
methods.description: Reads and parses an XML changelog file into a Document object.

methods.name: readChangeLogResource
methods.description: Reads an XML changelog resource from the classpath into a Document.

methods.name: readInputStream
methods.description: Converts an InputStream to a String using UTF-8 encoding.

methods.name: writeChangeLogFile
methods.description: Writes a Document object to a file as formatted XML.

methods.name: writeFile
methods.description: Writes string content to a specified file.
